semantic_cost_comparison.observation: matrix_by_name/SparseCado use u64 modulus and ordinary RHS system; underlying core supports wider modulus paths. A returned solution vector is not an arbitrary homogeneous kernel basis.
semantic_cost_comparison.consequence: Freeze exact modulus,width,rows,RHS and verification objective; no automatic GF(2) toy-race transfer.

semantic_cost_comparison.observation: Deferred methods wait for full-rank completion and use seeded equal-solution checks; preacceptance rank() is a placeholder. Underlying Solved explicitly does not certify rank.
semantic_cost_comparison.consequence: Compare with full-rank incremental oracle on the same rows; do not equate timing/rank with TargetPinned or promote seeded agreement into deterministic proof.

semantic_cost_comparison.observation: row_ops counts nonzero multiply-subtracts plus conversions/filter/fold/reconstruction/checks/returned Krylov products; all attempted report charges are summed. Small block arithmetic and dense scans are excluded by documented convention.
semantic_cost_comparison.consequence: row_ops is a scoped counter, not complete arithmetic/wall/memory cost or separate field-add/multiply counts; no whole-system cost claim.

semantic_cost_comparison.observation: FilterReport has input/output rows,columns,nonzeros and removal/merge counters; SparseSolveReport has filter/core dimensions/nonzeros,solver reports,attempts,reconstruction,row_ops.
semantic_cost_comparison.consequence: Reuse existing report types rather than infer no telemetry exists.
